newsitem.title: USA: PS Colo seeks open natural gas competition.
newsitem.headline: PS Colo seeks open natural gas competition.

text.p: Public Service Co of Colorado filed Thursday with the Colorado Public Utilities Commission a proposal for open competition in sales of natural gas.

"Our customers deserve a choice in who sells them natural gas, and we feel it is very important to take the final step in the deregulation of the natural gas commodity," said company president Wayne Brunetti.
PS Colorado's comments were filed in response to the commission's review of utility gas costs and proposed revisions to rules for natural gas utilities in Colorado.
According to Brunetti, open competition doesn't mean PS Colorado would exit the gas business.
He noted the utility would serve as a transporter of gas for the various suppliers that choose to operate in the Colorado market.
The Colorado Public Utilities Commission has scheduled a hearing on March 6 to review and discuss the processes and issues surrounding customer choice options for natural gas supply.
